tagline: 雅西卡旁轴相机，1973 年发布
description: 雅西卡于1973年推出的旁轴相机。配备Yashinon DX 40 mm f/2,8, filter thread 48 mm, closest distance 0,85 m。使用QL quick loading system, single-stroke advance lever, built-in double exposure prevention, film transport confirmation window.。

specs.镜头: Yashinon DX 40 mm f/2,8, filter thread 48 mm, closest distance 0,85 m
specs.取景器: Superimposed rangefinder, bright frame line, parallax correction mark, overexposure and underexposure warning arrows.
specs.胶片/画幅: QL quick loading system, single-stroke advance lever, built-in double exposure prevention, film transport confirmation window.
specs.电池: Two 1,35 volt mercury battery PX640, Battery check
specs.英文简介: The Electro 35 FC is a 35mm rangefinder camera released by Yashica in 1973.
